Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must meet NINCDS-ADRDA criteria for probable Alzheimer's disease (AD).
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No information provided about Alzheimer's diagnosis or NINCDS-ADRDA criteria fulfillment.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must have disrupted sleep, documented by clinical history and by 1 to 2 weeks of recording using wrist activity monitors.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No sleep history or actigraph data provided.
No mention of Alzheimer's diagnosis in patient history.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Hachinski Ischemia Scale score less than or equal to 4.
A 2-week history of two or more sleep disorder behaviors...
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No sleep disorder history or caregiver-reported data provided.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: CT or MRI since the onset of memory problems showing no more than one lacunar infarct...
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No CT/MRI findings or stroke history provided.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Physically acceptable for study as confirmed by medical history and exam...
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has a history of myocardial infarctions, coronary artery bypass, and ischemic cardiomyopathy, which may preclude physical acceptability.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Actigraph evidence of a mean nocturnal sleep time of less than 7 hours per night...
Stable home situation with no planned move during the 13-week investigational period.
Residing with responsible spouse, family member, or professional caregiver...
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Caregiver presence or role not specified.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Ability to ingest oral medication and participate in all scheduled evaluations.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is on metformin (oral medication) and no evidence of physical inability to participate.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Six grades of education or work history sufficient to exclude mental retardation.
Hamilton Depression Rating Scale score of 15 or less.
Stable medication (dose and type) for non-excluded concurrent medical conditions for 4 weeks prior to the screening visit.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Stability of medications (e.g., metformin) not explicitly confirmed.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Sleep disturbance is acute (within the last 2 weeks).
Sleep disturbance is associated with an acute illness with delirium.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No acute illness or delirium mentioned.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Clinically significant movement disorder that would interfere with the actigraph readings.
Not having a mobile upper extremity to which to attach an actigraph.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No information on upper extremity mobility.
Patient has a history of myocardial infarctions, coronary artery disease, and ischemic cardiomyopathy, indicating unstable medical status.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Use of investigational or unapproved medications within 4 weeks of the screening visit.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is on metformin, a standard medication, with no mention of investigational drugs.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient unwilling to maintain caffeine abstinence after 2:00 pm...
Patient unwilling to comply with the maximum limit of two alcoholic drinks per day...
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Alcohol consumption policies not addressed in patient data.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Use of melatonin within 2 weeks of screening visit.
Clinically significant abnormal laboratory findings that have not been approved by the Project Director.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Mild hepatic transaminases are noted, but approval status is unspecified.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Residing in a facility without a consistent caregiver present during the night...
Caregiver deemed too unreliable to supervise the wearing of the actigraph...
Autoimmune disease, such as rheumatoid arthritis and polymyalgia rheumatica.

Recap: Patient is 58 years old (meets age criterion), but lacks documentation for most inclusion criteria (AD diagnosis, sleep history, MMSE, Hachinski, etc.). Excluded due to unstable medical condition (myocardial infarctions, coronary artery disease, ischemic cardiomyopathy).
